hints.title: Non-Empty Subsequence Invariant
hints.text: The subsequences must be non-empty, so at least one product nums1[i] * nums2[j] must be included.

hints.title: 2D State Definition
hints.text: Let state(i, j) be the maximum dot product using prefixes nums1[0..i] and nums2[0..j].

hints.title: Four Transitions
hints.text: state(i, j) = max(nums1[i]*nums2[j], nums1[i]*nums2[j] + max(0, state(i-1, j-1)), state(i-1, j), state(i, j-1)).
